scheduleLabel: 753 archived FBS–FBS regular-season games, excluding conference title games

validation.scope: Each model scored the same 2,264 archived FBS–FBS games from 2023–2025, including some conference title games. Team strength was frozen before any games in the target season.
validation.calibration: The preseason odds mapping was fitted on 2014–2019 games. The team model uses our own scores, opponent network, and venue adjustment.

quarterbacks.description: These are separate player estimates from prior recorded passing yards and attempts. Three dated school records illustrate returning, transfer, and first-year evidence. National preseason roster coverage is still unverified.

validation.scope: The 2024–2025 replay scored player-seasons with at least 100 observed FBS attempts. It tests passing efficiency conditional on playing.

examples.fact: Clemson’s spring guide identified Klubnik as the returning starter. His prior college passing record was at Clemson.
Miami confirmed Beck joined the team from Georgia. His prior college production follows his player ID to the new school.
Michigan announced Underwood as an incoming quarterback. The signing established his affiliation before the cutoff.

limits: This is a retrospective replay on recorded fixtures. Final archive schedules can include later changes, and the archive misses some results. Win totals cover the scored FBS–FBS cohort. A dated prospective forecast starts with the next preseason.
featureStatus: The preview uses the four-season team baseline. Quarterback evidence is shown separately until dated roster coverage supports a fair team forecast test. Coaching data is pending a dated coverage check.
